Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
很久以前，古代的人很不知道什么植物能吃，也什么植物不能吃。所以很多人常常吃不安全的植物，吃不安全的植物对你的身体有坏处，很麻烦的情况。但是一个人，神农，要解决这个问题。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. At the opening, add the consequence of people’s uncertainty to make the danger more vivid: “很多人吃了有毒的植物，常常生病。”
2. After introducing Shennong, show his determination through an internal thought: “神农想：我一定要找出能吃的植物！”
3. Add a feeling to show why the situation matters to people: “他们不知道该吃什么，心里很担心。”

ideas.reason: It gives a concrete consequence that fits the danger in the scene.
It shows Shennong's motivation and fits his role in the tale.
It adds a natural feeling that follows from not knowing which plants are safe.
